properties.description: Eight tests: no bad news names nothing and says an untested design looks the same; a failed run reaches the accepted decision with its path; a proposed decision is not listed; good news is counted and nothing is written onto the decision; a recorded failure is kept apart from a failed run; an open defect finding reaches its decision and a closed one does not; bad news under no decision is named; decisions come back in id order, not by evidence count.
properties.name: Bad news reaches the settled decision behind it — unranked, no threshold, good news counted not stored
